facts.where: Table 6 caption
facts.quote: Table 6: Zero-shot evaluation, all metrics. The agents and interfaces of Table 1 with success-only and all-trial metrics, averaged over 22 tasks with 5 seeds each. “Success only” excludes trials with any failed subtasks. EEF cmds counts the distinct end-effector commands the agent gives the simulator; Turns/EEF, Calls/EEF and Wall/EEF divide a trial’s model turns (requests to the model, each of which can issue several tool calls), tool calls and wall time (excluding offline Blender rendering) by that count. † A lower bound, as in Table 1 .
facts.note: "Success only" excludes trials with any failed subtasks; EEF cmds = distinct end-effector commands; Wall/EEF excludes offline Blender rendering; the dagger marks a lower bound as in Table 1
